purpose: Determine whether the position-rate/speed to probability-statistics expression is a valid governed projection hierarchy in which the RT core condition is re-expressed as related conditions across qualitative, metric, realization, and domain layers.
central_hypothesis: The primary expression preserves the bounded relational grammar of RT while changing operator type and domain binding: <*>_X remains the RT core coupling operator, ->_x is a downstream projection operator, and <Bridge> is a typed realization-residue relation connecting probability and statistics.

included: Structural comparison between the primary expression and the RT core expression
Projection hierarchy from RT core to related domain conditions
Orientation and ordering as prior to temporal projection
Monotonicity as a candidate condition for directed propagation and temporal projection
Qualitative propagation position and qualitative rate as prior to metric position and speed
Generation of a qualitative probability metric from position-rate coupling
Resolution of the qualitative probability metric through RT admissibility and mismatch evaluation
Probability-statistics separation and their realization-residue bridge
Recursive feedback from accumulated statistical organization to future admissibility
Candidate quantum_app relevance of the probability branch
Candidate geometry and GR_app relevance of the statistics branch
excluded: Claim that RT derives quantum mechanics
Claim that RT derives General Relativity
Claim that probability equals quantum mechanics
Claim that statistics equals General Relativity
Insertion of metric time, distance, speed, probability, or physical constants as primitives
Introduction of c before an independent propagation-ceiling derivation
Use of structural resemblance as proof of semantic equivalence

authoritative_constraints: RT_core is unchanged and remains the domain-neutral formal source.
Time is not primitive; it is a projection of orientation and ordering.
The sequence index k denotes ordering only and must not be interpreted as primitive time.
Qualitative rate is prior to metric speed or velocity.
Propagation position is prior to metric spatial position.
Probability is an admissibility-ranked landscape before optional numerical calibration.
Statistics is accumulated realized organization rather than probability under another name.
Probability and statistics are non-identical but may be projectionally coupled through realization and residue.
<*>_X is the RT core admissibility-conditioned coupling operator.
<Bridge> must be typed and must not be read as equality.
Each projection is provisional, governed, and claim-limited.
Active failure-seeking is required before promotion.

definitions_for_analysis.orientation: A declared relational direction or ordering reference phi under which distinctions and continuations can be compared.
definitions_for_analysis.ordering: A non-temporal precedence or comparability relation among admissible continuations.
definitions_for_analysis.monotonic_continuation: An oriented continuation whose propagation position is order-preserving relative to phi until exclusion, closure, or boundary contact.
definitions_for_analysis.time_app: A governed projection that reads oriented ordering as temporal organization; it is not a primitive container in which continuation occurs.
definitions_for_analysis.propagation_position: The organizational position of an admissible continuation within a bounded symmetry gradient.
definitions_for_analysis.qualitative_rate: The ordered change or continuation tendency of organization relative to phi before metric duration or distance calibration.
definitions_for_analysis.speed_app: A metric domain projection of qualitative rate after spatial and temporal calibration; use velocity_app when orientation must be preserved.
definitions_for_analysis.qualitative_probability_metric: An ordinal admissibility landscape over candidate continuations generated from the joint constraints of propagation position and qualitative rate.
definitions_for_analysis.statistics: Accumulated realized organization produced by repeated closure and recorded through residue.
definitions_for_analysis.probability_statistics_bridge: A typed, non-identity relation in which probability conditions possible realization, realized closure contributes to statistics, and statistical residue modifies future admissibility and probability.
definitions_for_analysis.related_condition: A domain-bound re-expression of the RT core condition that preserves declared invariants without requiring literal operator or symbol identity.
definitions_for_analysis.projection_hierarchy: A governed genealogy in which successive projection operators re-express an inherited RT condition in increasingly domain-specific terms.

<*>_X.meaning: Admissibility-conditioned relation between non-identical bounded terms or blocks.

->_x.meaning: Projects a source condition into a related condition under declared domain, orientation, or application context x.
must_not_be_read_as: causal implication without a projection rule

<Bridge>.meaning: Connects prospective admissible organization to accumulated realized organization and returns residue-conditioned feedback to future admissibility.

structural_correspondence_to_test.candidate_relationship: The projection form re-expresses the RT relational condition under domain binding while preserving bounded relational organization and changing operator semantics by layer.
structural_correspondence_to_test.required_distinction: Same relational grammar does not imply same operator, same information content, or semantic equivalence.

candidate_projection_hierarchy.role: Possible organization related to accumulated realized organization

resolution_sequence: Evaluate each candidate under the declared symmetry and orientation reference.
Order surviving candidates by qualitative mismatch or compatibility.
Permit numerical calibration only through a separate governed projection.

probability_statistics_dynamics.expanded_cycle: [pi_P_n r_Q_n] ->_x P_n -> realization_n -> Sigma_n -> delta_R_n -> A_n_plus_1 -> P_n_plus_1
probability_statistics_dynamics.non_markov_candidate: Residual delta is the mechanism by which realized history modifies future admissibility.

candidate_monotonicity_condition.strict_form: If a non-null distinction successfully continues, pi_P(x_k_plus_1, phi) >_phi pi_P(x_k, phi).
candidate_monotonicity_condition.interpretation: Monotonicity converts orientation and ordering into directed propagation and may permit temporal projection.
candidate_monotonicity_condition.claim_limit: Monotonicity supplies direction and ordinal progress but does not by itself supply metric interval, duration, or speed.
candidate_monotonicity_condition.open_issue: Determine whether monotonicity is necessary, sufficient, or one member of a larger rate-well-definedness predicate.

members.name: RATE_OR_SPEED
members.role: Oriented continuation, qualitative before metric projection

members.name: PROBABILITY_STATISTICS_BRIDGE_OBJECT
members.role: Possible organization related to accumulated realized organization

candidate_triad.note: The third member is relational rather than scalar. The triad is structural, not a claim that all three values are jointly exact or mutually invertible.

supported_discussion: statistical organization as a candidate precursor to metric geometry

domain_relevance.candidate_transition_location: The probability-statistics realization-residue bridge is a candidate location for studying a quantum-like possibility layer to geometry-like accumulated organization transition.

agent_mission.primary_question: Does the proposed expression define a coherent, non-circular, form-related projection hierarchy traceable to RT_core?
secondary_questions: Which invariants of the RT core condition survive each projection level?
Which features are introduced by domain binding rather than inherited from RT?
Does the position-rate condition genuinely constrain a qualitative probability landscape?
Can RT qualitative calculus resolve that landscape without importing a numerical measure?
Can the probability-statistics bridge be typed as a realization-residue process rather than an analogy?
Is the statistical feedback sufficient to make the process non-Markov?
Does monotonicity support temporal and rate projection without importing primitive time?
Are metric position and speed legitimate downstream projections of propagation position and qualitative rate?
Can quantum_app and GR_app discussions remain traceable without exceeding their claim ceilings?
Is the hierarchy compositionally consistent when the same domain condition is reached by different projection paths?

required_analysis_tasks.name: NORMALIZE_TERMS_AND_TYPES
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Assign a type, domain, codomain, and claim layer to every term and operator in the primary expression. Preserve the distinction among core coupling, projection, and bridge operators.

required_analysis_tasks.name: TEST_STRUCTURAL_CORRESPONDENCE
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Compare the primary expression with RT := [a <*>_X b]. Identify preserved relational grammar, changed operator semantics, and any illegitimate substitution.

required_analysis_tasks.name: BUILD_PROJECTION_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Produce a directed dependency graph from RT_core through orientation, ordering, position, rate, probability, realization, statistics, residue, metric projection, and domain application. Mark every imported assumption.

required_analysis_tasks.name: FORMALIZE_RELATED_CONDITION
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Propose a minimal definition of related condition and specify what must be preserved for a projection to remain genealogically traceable to RT_core.

required_analysis_tasks.name: ANALYZE_MONOTONICITY
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Determine whether monotonicity is necessary or sufficient for directed propagation, temporal projection, bounded ceilings, and rate well-definedness. Supply counterexamples involving plateaus, reversals, cycles, branching, and reference changes.

required_analysis_tasks.name: TEST_PROBABILITY_RESOLUTION
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Construct a finite qualitative example in which position and qualitative rate constrain several candidate continuations. Resolve them using only RT admissibility and ordinal mismatch classes. Do not introduce numerical probabilities.

required_analysis_tasks.name: TYPE_THE_PROBABILITY_STATISTICS_BRIDGE
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Replace <Bridge> with one or more candidate typed operators. State directionality, information flow, residue update, loss of information, reversibility limits, and whether feedback is required.

required_analysis_tasks.name: TEST_RECURSIVE_CLOSURE
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Determine whether P_n -> realization -> Sigma_n -> delta_R_n -> A_n+1 -> P_n+1 forms a lawful repeated process and identify the exact missing residue update and decay rules.

required_analysis_tasks.name: TEST_PROJECTION_PATH_CONSISTENCY
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Compare direct and multi-stage projection routes into the same target domain. Determine whether their outputs preserve compatible conditions and define the equivalence relation represented by projection-path consistency.

required_analysis_tasks.name: SEPARATE_APPLICATION_CLAIMS
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Identify exactly what the architecture permits one to discuss about quantum behavior and GR-like geometry, and list the missing mathematical and empirical structures preventing derivation claims.

required_analysis_tasks.name: RUN_ADVERSARIAL_FAILURE_CAMPAIGN
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Actively construct countermodels for every major candidate claim. Do not repair failures by silently broadening definitions.

required_analysis_tasks.name: ISSUE_RESEARCH_VERDICT
required_analysis_tasks.instruction: Classify each candidate as coherent, underdefined, contradicted, redundant, or ready for bounded formalization. No candidate may be promoted by this packet.

minimum_constructive_examples: A linear monotonic continuation with three candidate next states
A plateau in propagation position with non-null distinction
A cycle that satisfies local ordering but lacks global monotonicity
A branching continuation with equal qualitative rate and different positions
Two candidates with equal position and different rates
A coarse-grained statistical organization producing ambiguous geometry

failure_classes_to_hunt.description: The hierarchy preserves visual form but no RT invariant.
Ordering indices or rate definitions assume temporal duration before time_app is projected.
Propagation position is defined using spatial distance or coordinates before metric projection.
The qualitative probability metric requires normalization, measure, or frequency before the statistics bridge.
A monotonic eligible process still lacks a unique or stable qualitative rate.
Changing phi reverses probability rankings or propagation direction without a governed transformation law.
Probability is reduced to observed frequency or statistics is treated as a probability distribution without a typed bridge.
Feedback to future admissibility depends on an unspecified residue update or decay law.
Direct and staged projections into the same domain produce incompatible related conditions.
A downstream projection contains distinctions not inherited, calibrated, or declared as domain additions.
Probability and projection incompatibility are presented as a derivation of quantum mechanics or uncertainty.
Accumulated statistics are presented as General Relativity without an intervening geometry and dynamics construction.
Any domain outcome can be redescribed as an RT projection after observation.
The proposed third member is only a label bundle and adds no relational constraint to position and rate.

agent_execution_rules: Do not modify source files or RT_core.
Do not invent missing definitions silently.
Label every new definition as PROPOSED.
Separate inherited RT structure from domain-added assumptions.
Separate structural, mathematical, and empirical support.
Record negative results as useful induction outcomes.
Treat quantum_app and GR_app as application-layer labels only.
Return one complete JSON result matching required_output.
End with the smallest next induction capable of resolving the highest-severity blocker.
success_criteria: The agent produces a typed interpretation of every operator and block.
The agent determines whether the shared RT form is invariant-preserving or merely syntactic.
The agent provides at least one finite qualitative probability-resolution example.
The agent proposes and compares at least two typed probability-statistics bridge candidates.
The agent tests monotonicity against plateaus, reversals, cycles, branching, and reference changes.
The agent identifies the exact residue update information still missing.
The agent evaluates direct versus staged projection consistency.
The agent states precise quantum_app and GR_app claim ceilings.
The agent reports countermodels and unresolved risks without promotion language.
final_instruction: Analyze whether [[position rate/speed] ->_x [probability <Bridge> statistics]] is a lawful projection-hierarchy expression related to RT := [a <*>_X b]. Preserve the distinction between core coupling and projection. Treat each hierarchy level as a possible re-expression of the RT condition in a different domain or organizational layer. Attempt to falsify the hierarchy before refining it, and return the required JSON induction result without modifying or promoting RT_core.
